findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Spectrum/Prime/Topology.lean:1266-1268 is the internal term copied at diff lines 205-214; grep for equivIrreducibleComponents_apply|coe_equivIrreducibleComponents returns nothing (no public value lemma), but zeroLocus_minimalPrimes (Topology.lean:1277) gives the image equality supplying the value.
findings.fix: Drop minimalPrimesEquiv/equivIrreducibleComponentsVal/equivIrreducibleComponents_val/minimalPrimesEquiv_val and build the equiv minimalPrimes R ≃ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum R) directly from the public lemma zeroLocus_minimalPrimes (Topology.lean:1277), whose value at q is zeroLocus q.val by construction (injectivity of zeroLocus ∘ (↑) on minimal primes from PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_iff, primes being radical); then minimalPrimesEquiv_val holds by rfl and no internal term is copied.
findings.issue: equivIrreducibleComponents_val and its helper equivIrreducibleComponentsVal (line 181) reproduce Mathlib's minimalPrimes.equivIrreducibleComponents construction verbatim (the OrderIso.setOfMinimalIsoSetOfMaximal ((show … ≃o PrimeSpectrum R …).trans ((pointsEquivIrreducibleCloseds R).trans (IrreducibleCloseds.orderIsoSubtype' _).dual)) term, lines 205-214) inside a cast/congrArg motive solely to extract the equiv's value. This duplicates a Mathlib internal definition and is unstable against any change to it.

summary: The main theorems and RingTheory/topology reuse are genuinely new and sound. The remaining defect is equivIrreducibleComponentsVal/equivIrreducibleComponents_val, which copies the internal construction body of Mathlib's minimalPrimes.equivIrreducibleComponents verbatim inside a cast motive to recover a value that the public lemma zeroLocus_minimalPrimes already provides.
